name: X Account
tagline: Use your own signed-in X developer application
description: The official xurl bridge connects the X MCP endpoint with your own user authorization. Set up your own developer application and complete xurl login on this computer before connecting. X does not support native MCP dynamic OAuth registration. Actions depend on the permissions you authorize and your X API plan.

prompts.text: Read the posts that my authorized account can access.
Draft an X post from this document and show it to me before posting.

auth.label: Own X account
steps: Set up the official xurl CLI with your own X developer application.
Complete xurl OAuth sign-in on this computer with the permissions you need.
Return here and connect. Review any write action before you send it.
auth.note: Your own X app and user authorization are required. OpenBot does not supply a shared OAuth client or credits.
